review.notes: All four weighted objective groups and their July 28, 2026 bullets are mapped to product boundaries, worked decision flows, an integrated scenario, and five hands-on labs. All 49 cited URLs are exact source-catalog entries. One O'Reilly and one Udemy SC-900 course page returned HTTP 403 to the automated monitor and are treated as access-blocked rather than missing. Agent ID terminology, availability, licensing, service plans, portal surfaces, coverage, pricing, and supported features remain explicitly marked VERIFY CURRENT.

findings.title: October workload identity and threat intelligence need broader explanation
findings.evidence: New revision names workload identities and Microsoft Threat Intelligence.
findings.recommendation: Map all 58 bullets and expand both concepts while retaining July baseline.
findings.resolution: Map all 58 bullets and expand both concepts while retaining July baseline.

findings.title: Application definitions and local grants are different objects
findings.evidence: Workloads include applications, service principals and managed identities; tenant instances hold local access.
findings.recommendation: Add explicit two-tenant example and lifecycle/authorization explanation.
findings.resolution: Add explicit two-tenant example and lifecycle/authorization explanation.

findings.title: Human MFA controls do not apply to all software identities
findings.evidence: Supported service-principal CA uses direct targeting/block controls and excludes managed identities and multitenant/third-party SaaS.
findings.recommendation: Add subject-specific policy explanation and answer.
findings.resolution: Add subject-specific policy explanation and answer.

findings.title: Retirement deadlines differ by user population
findings.evidence: September Learn distinguishes February 1 most/internal-guest users and July 1 Global Administrator/external users; July blog was broader.
findings.recommendation: Add dated current guidance, provider/cloud scope and follow-ups.
findings.resolution: Add dated current guidance, provider/cloud scope and follow-ups.

findings.title: Preferred method is not an enforced strength
findings.evidence: System-preferred can offer strongest registered method while allowing alternatives; CA remains separate.
findings.recommendation: Distinguish enablement, registration, preference and requirement.
findings.resolution: Distinguish enablement, registration, preference and requirement.

findings.title: Completed reviews need application and source-aware remediation
findings.evidence: Denied decisions do not remove access until applicable results are applied; nested/dynamic/on-premises paths differ.
findings.recommendation: Add three-person worked example and effective-access checks.
findings.resolution: Add three-person worked example and effective-access checks.

findings.title: Subnet and rule changes do not prove intended isolation
findings.evidence: NSG default virtual-network allowance, priority and stateful existing-flow behavior matter.
findings.recommendation: Add segmentation explanation and new-versus-existing connection example.
findings.resolution: Add segmentation explanation and new-versus-existing connection example.

findings.title: New-resource default does not migrate existing vaults
findings.evidence: API 2026-02-01 changes new-vault default; existing access configuration is retained.
findings.recommendation: Add configuration versus secret-read authorization and default boundary.
findings.resolution: Add configuration versus secret-read authorization and default boundary.

findings.title: Posture coverage and scores need current scope
findings.evidence: New Azure subscriptions require CSPM opt-in from October 27; classic Secure Score and Cloud Score differ.
findings.recommendation: Add scoped lifecycle note and blank-dashboard interpretation.
findings.resolution: Add scoped lifecycle note and blank-dashboard interpretation.

findings.title: Threat context is distinct from local incident proof
findings.evidence: Current TI overview includes reports, entities and preview-specific experiences.
findings.recommendation: Add report/match/confirmed incident distinction and qualify ISOC prerequisites.
findings.resolution: Add report/match/confirmed incident distinction and qualify ISOC prerequisites.

findings.title: Vulnerability finding is not confirmed exploitation or installed patch
findings.recommendation: Explain vulnerability-management purpose at fundamentals depth.
findings.resolution: Explain vulnerability-management purpose at fundamentals depth.

findings.title: Label availability does not prove content application
findings.evidence: Publishing distributes labels/settings; applying protection is separate.

findings.title: Retention needs actual start and end dates
findings.evidence: Ordinary retention precedence compares item endpoints, not just nominal number of years.
findings.recommendation: Add 2028 versus 2031 example and hold/priority-cleanup limits.
findings.resolution: Add 2028 versus 2031 example and hold/priority-cleanup limits.

findings.title: Explorer content permissions are privileged and separate
findings.evidence: List/content roles are independent; content viewing can supersede item-local permissions under service limits.
findings.recommendation: Clarify current Data Explorer terminology while retaining blueprint Content explorer wording.
findings.resolution: Clarify current Data Explorer terminology while retaining blueprint Content explorer wording.

limitations: Accepted July 28 snapshot preserved; 58 October 21 bullets mapped separately.
No identity, Conditional Access, access review, NSG, Key Vault, Purview, Sentinel, credential or other tenant action executed. Seven labs are learner exercises/tabletops.
Current passkey dates are population/provider/cloud specific; enrolled/registered/preferred does not establish enforced authentication strength or tenant rollout.
Threat-intelligence ISOC and vulnerability-management portal experiences include preview scope. Current tenant access and licensing not independently tested.

Paid lessons/question banks not reviewed; O'Reilly and Udemy blocked. Partner/Whizlabs/YouTube/Service Trust shells and direct practice empty response do not establish underlying content. Earlier runtimes explicitly historical; current Learn module total not timed.
First blog public article read; second reviewed only introduction/initial-access/mitigation sections, not all technical queries/indicators. No attack reproduction or gated intelligence access.
